title: The Massive rock by the road
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：massive　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 massive 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the postman wrote of ① a massive rock by the road in the list, and everybody in the office said at once that it was ② more massive than the one named there the year before. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the postman, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the massive ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most massive rock by the road anybody in the office had ever seen, or so the list for June 1958 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too massive to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the sender who had come to help; the massive ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the envelope at the far box, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a massive debt of the company, and said that no sender in his right mind would call it ⑥ as massive as the debt of the company they had once had in the old office. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was massive or not, and he said so.

By 1971 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the list. What the line asked for was ⑦ something massive, and nothing besides. The sender from the next office called the whole plan ⑧ quite massive; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the list kept the names of the massive ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1974, at once, she wrote of another massive rock by the road in the same list, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ more massive than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most massive debt of the company in the whole office, she said in 1976, was the one she could never quite name; the massive ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 巨大（前置定语 a massive rock by the road：1964 年邮差在收发清单里记下的那件巨大的岩石）
B. adj. 巨大／大规模（比较级 more massive than：文中两处，一处比路边巨大的岩石，一处比预想）
C. adj. 巨大／大规模（最高级 the most massive：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 巨大（表语 too massive to do：母亲觉得它太巨大，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 大规模（前置定语 a massive debt of the company：叔叔把整件事称作一桩大规模的巨额债务）
F. adj. 大规模（同级比较 as massive as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩公司欠下的巨额债务相比）
G. adj. 大规模（后置定语 something massive：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 大规模（受程度副词修饰 quite massive：那位寄信人的评价）

items.q: a massive rock by the road
the most massive rock by the road anybody
a massive debt of the company
The most massive debt of the company in

answers.why: massive 意为“巨大”，1964 年邮差在收发清单里记下的是“一件巨大的岩石”，此处作前置定语 a massive rock by the road。
massive 意为“巨大”，此处用比较级 more massive than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
massive 意为“巨大”，收发清单上 六月 那行字说它是邮局里最巨大的一件，故用最高级 the most massive rock by the road。
massive 意为“巨大”，母亲认为这件东西“太巨大了，谁也用不上”，too massive to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
massive 意为“大规模”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩大规模的巨额债务”，此处作前置定语 a massive debt of the company。
massive 意为“大规模”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩公司欠下的巨额债务一样大规模”，同级比较用 as massive as。
massive 意为“大规模”，收发清单上那半行字要的是“大规模的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something massive。
massive 意为“大规模”，邻邮局来的那位寄信人认为这套计划“相当大规模”，quite 修饰原级 massive。
massive 意为“大规模”，1974 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要大规模”，故用比较级 more massive than。
massive 意为“大规模”，母亲 1976 年说的是“整个邮局里最大规模的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most massive debt of the company。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1964 年，邮差在收发清单里记下了一件巨大的岩石。（a massive rock by the road）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更巨大。（more massive than …）
母亲觉得它太巨大，谁也用不上。（too massive to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩大规模的巨额债务。（a massive debt of the company）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩公司欠下的巨额债务一样大规模。（as massive as …）
到了 1971 年，收发清单上只剩半行字：要的是一件大规模的东西。（something massive）
answers: In 1964 the postman wrote of a massive rock by the road in the list.
Everybody said it was more massive than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too massive to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a massive debt of the company.
He said nobody would call it as massive as the debt of the company they had once had.
By 1971 the list asked for nothing but something massive.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 massive 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1964 the postman wrote of a massive rock by the road in the list, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most massive rock by the road in the office, or so the list says.
My mother thought it too massive to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a massive debt of the company, and nobody argued with him.
The sender from the next office called the plan quite massive, and everybody laughed.
The massive ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
